title: A checkout path for $5 Pollen
summary:
A day of untangling image and vision failures, making rate limits more consistent, and clarifying checkout and service terms.

The +$5 Pollen button was connected to checkout. The other bundle buttons remain disabled.

Two PRs addressed the same missing import that broke Kontext generation and editing. Nanobanana requests also lost a hardcoded 25-second timeout that could cut off slower generations, especially those using reference images.

Vision requests with image_url content no longer fail validation when the optional detail field is omitted. Prompt-filter responses can also omit content_filter_results.
